# netbox_contact_assignments (Data Source)

Lists contact_assignment objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_contact_assignments" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: contact_id, contact_id__n, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, object_id, object_id__n, object_type, object_type__n, role_id, role_id__n, tag, tag__any, tag__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `contact_assignments` (Attributes List) The matching contact_assignments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contact_assignments))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--contact_assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contact_assignments`

Read-Only:

- `contact_id` (Number) Id of the contact.
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `object_id` (Number) Id of the object the contact is assigned to.
- `object_type` (String) Content type of the object the contact is assigned to (dcim.site, dcim.device, tenancy.tenant, ...).
- `priority` (String) Priority of the contact for this object. One of: primary, secondary, tertiary, inactive.
- `role_id` (Number) Id of the contact role. Once set it cannot be removed, only changed: NetBox rejects a null. If you drop it from the config, keep a depends_on on the role so it is destroyed after the assignment.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
